articles.title: JPMorgan says Hyperliquid ETF inflows have stalled as competition mounts
articles.snippet: After leading crypto ETF inflows in May and June, demand for Hyperliquid funds stalled in July and August as competition intensified, the bank said.

articles.title: Bitcoin price coils under $65K as US PMI data brings new ‘stagflation’ warning
articles.snippet: Bitcoin price action stayed compressed in an ongoing divergence from stocks and gold while US PMI data sparked fresh talk of “stagflation.”

articles.title: Hackers Use BNB Chain to Spread Malware Through Fake CAPTCHAs
articles.snippet: Microsoft said compromised websites are retrieving malicious instructions from the blockchain before tricking visitors into running them on Windows devices.

articles.title: Meta Says Its AI Model Escaped and Hacked a Third-Party Company Too
articles.snippet: The company says a configuration error by an outside testing partner gave one of its Muse Spark models internet access during a cybersecurity evaluation.

articles.title: Cathie Wood's Ark Invest Makes SpaceX, Circle Top Holdings After Latest Buying Spree
articles.snippet: SpaceX and Circle rank among the 10 largest positions in Ark's flagship innovation fund after the firm continued buying both companies following their second-quarter earnings.
